newsitem.title: CHINA: Japanese bank in first China joint yuan loan.
newsitem.headline: Japanese bank in first China joint yuan loan.

text.p: Japan's Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd and the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China have put together the first-ever co-financing Chinese yuan loan agreement, a spokesman for the Japanese bank said on Monday.

The official said the agreement, providing a credit line to Shanghai Sharp Electrical Equipment Co. Ltd., will be signed on Tuesday. He said the loan was for a fairly small sum, but declined to give details.
"This is the first time for a foreign bank with the right to do local currency business to arrange a co-financing agreement with a local bank," the spokesman said.
Tokyo-Mitsubishi is one of nine foreign banks so far granted approval by China's central bank to conduct yuan business.
